title: Subtitle translation checked line by line
description: The original, the audio and the translation are available side by side so a specific line can be checked.

blocks.text: A translation can distort the meaning even when recognition is accurate. The editor needs to know which layer they are fixing right now.

quote.text: pague la suscripcion mensual empresarial para traducir videos de 30 min y nada no los traduce solamente crea los subtitulos pero no lo traduce al idioma que eliges

blocks.text: Link the pairs of lines and flag the translation after the original changes. Add an agreed glossary of the project’s names and terms.
Check the directions of writing, the line breaks and the display time. A line that is correct in the editor still has to read in the finished frame.
